Operation.comment: One published API operation — an HTTP endpoint (operationId/method/path) that invokes a Choreograph workflow. Materializes to an OpenAPI paths/{path}/{method} PathItem. The OpenAPI FACE (vocab_to_openapi, EA-3 Seq 9) is the peer of vocab_to_shacl: a deterministic projection of these triples into an OpenAPI 3.x document.

api:operationId.source: the unique operation id (e.g. 'createTask'); the OpenAPI operationId and the identity key the WorkflowBinding's bindsOperation references

api:method.source: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS

api:path.source: the HTTP path relative to the server root (e.g. '/tasks/{id}'); path params marked as {name}

api:summary.source: short human-readable summary of the operation

api:description.source: longer human-readable description of what the operation does

api:deprecated.source: whether this operation is deprecated (default false)

api:hasBinding.source: reference to the api:WorkflowBinding implementing this operation's invocation

Parameter.comment: One input parameter on an Operation. Carries name, location (query/path/header/cookie), required/optional, and a bare datatype token. Materializes to an entry in the OpenAPI PathItem 'parameters' array (datatype mapped to the OpenAPI primitive type).

api:name.source: parameter name (e.g. 'id'); must match the OpenAPI parameter name and any {name} in the path

api:in.source: parameter location: query, path, header, cookie (the OpenAPI 'in' field)

api:required.source: whether this parameter is mandatory (path params are always required in OpenAPI)

api:datatype.source: bare datatype token (string, integer, long, float, double, boolean, dateTime, uri) — NO xsd: prefix; mapped to the OpenAPI primitive schema type by the materializer

api:ofOperation.source: reference to the api:Operation this parameter belongs to

Response.comment: One response variant from an Operation (success 200/201 or an error code 400/401/403/404/409/500). Carries statusCode + description. Materializes to an entry in the OpenAPI operation 'responses' map.

api:description.source: human-readable description of when this response occurs

api:ofOperation.source: reference to the api:Operation this response belongs to

api:errorCode.source: for error responses: the machine-readable error code (e.g. 'invalid_input', 'forbidden', 'unknown_workflow') per the CA-1 standard error shape

WorkflowBinding.comment: THE SEAM. Links an api:Operation to a Choreograph workflow: declares the workflow name, executor mode (gated|dumb, per CA-1 §3), auth requirement, and — crucially — the I/O payload schemas as JSON-Schema STRING LITERALS (CA-1 invocation-binding contract). api:inputSchema / api:outputSchema are verbatim JSON content carried in a string literal; the OpenAPI materializer parses them and embeds them UNCHANGED into components/schemas (zero translation — the clean layer split: the contract alphabet stays in SHACL, the JSON Schema stays in OpenAPI).

api:bindsOperation.source: reference to the api:Operation this binding implements; its operationId is the OpenAPI operationId

api:workflowName.source: the Choreograph workflow name resolved by handle_api_operation (CA-1 Seq 10, deferred) at invocation time

api:executor.source: executor mode: 'gated' (agent-powered, LLM cost, entitlement-gated) or 'dumb' (deterministic Loom pipeline, no agent, no cost) per CA-1 §3; surfaced as the OpenAPI x-executor extension

api:requiresAuth.source: whether the operation requires authentication (default true; all published APIs are owner-gated per CA-1 §5)

api:inputSchema.source: JSON Schema (as a STRING LITERAL of JSON content) for the workflow's input args. Passed VERBATIM by the OpenAPI materializer into the request body schema; NO translation by Emporium. If absent, the request body is omitted.

api:outputSchema.source: JSON Schema (as a STRING LITERAL of JSON content) for the workflow's output. Passed VERBATIM into the 200-response schema; NO translation by Emporium. If absent, the 200 response carries no schema.

Server.comment: A server hosting the API. Materializes to an entry in the OpenAPI top-level 'servers' array. One Server per environment (dev/canary/prod) or one default per deployment.

api:environment.source: environment tag (dev, canary, prod) for organizing multiple servers

comment: The Sophia API publication vocabulary (EA-3 Seq 9 / UC-2). Declares published API operations as born-RDF triples: a single source (the published api: triples) yields many faces — Turtle/SHACL (validation), and the OpenAPI 3.x face (vocab_to_openapi, the peer of vocab_to_shacl). The api:WorkflowBinding connects Operations to Choreograph workflows; its api:inputSchema / api:outputSchema are JSON-Schema STRING LITERALS (the CA-1 invocation-binding boundary), passed VERBATIM into the OpenAPI components/schemas with zero translation. The LIVE endpoint (handle_api_operation -> Choreograph /api/workflows/run) is CA-1's (Seq 10), gated on CA-1's dumb-executor + error-shape + GET /api/workflows/{name}/schema demand-signals — explicitly DEFERRED, not part of this face. api: subjects are URN-space; the projection lives ONLY in urn:mnemosyne:local:graph:{id}:projection:api and is DERIVED/regenerable, never source of truth.
description: A minimal example API publication vocabulary: api:Operation (an HTTP endpoint), api:Parameter, api:Response, api:WorkflowBinding (the Operation -> Choreograph workflow seam carrying JSON-Schema I/O literals + executor mode), and api:Server. Authored to exercise the OpenAPI FACE — vocab_to_openapi emits a valid OpenAPI 3.x document, served via content negotiation as application/openapi+json.
name: sophia-api
title: Sophia API Publication Vocabulary
